Foad Moslem
  • Interdisciplinary researcher with a background in experimental aeroacoustics, bio-inspired propeller design, and aerodynamic noise reduction for unmanned and urban air systems.
  • Published author with publications spanning bio-inspired propeller planform testing, deep reinforcement learning for flow control, and insect-flight aerodynamics, with hands-on experience in wind tunnel and anechoic chamber testing, microphone array measurement, and acoustic signal processing.
  • Interested in investigating rotor and propeller tonal noise, particularly blade geometry effects and installation-driven interaction noise, to advance experimentally grounded low-noise rotor design for the next generation of aerial transportation.
